title: Nashville's Little Peace of Country Heaven
description:
It’s back! Freshly lived‑in, well‑kept, and ready for guests again. Enjoy a comfy country setting just minutes from Nashville. This spacious home features four bedrooms, two full baths, one half bath, and a wonderful screened‑in back porch perfect for sipping coffee on cool, quiet mornings.

The house sits on several acres with a large backyard ideal for relaxing, playing, or catching some sun. Peaceful country living with room to breathe — all just 15–20 minutes from downtown Nashville.

The space
The primary suite offers a  Queen Bed, a spacious walk‑in closet, dual‑vanity bath, and a private door opening directly onto the screened‑in back porch — a quiet retreat for morning coffee or evening unwinding.

Bedroom 2 features a comfortable Full size (double) bed, a generous closet, and views toward the front porch, giving it a warm, welcoming feel.

Bedroom 3 is a charming, cozy room overlooking the front yard, furnished with a twin bed and a large desk — ideal for remote work or quiet reading.

Bedroom 4 sits privately upstairs, offering a Queen bed, an optional twin bed, a roomy layout with sloped ceilings and its own attached half bath. It’s a peaceful hideaway perfect for guests who appreciate extra space and privacy.

Guest access
My home will be yours all to yourself while you are staying.

Other things to note
The gravel driveway is spacious and easy to navigate, with plenty of room for multiple vehicles. You’ll have comfortable parking for 4 cars, and can easily accommodate more if needed. RV parking is welcome as well.
Please note that the garage is not available for guest use. My two farm cats access the garage, so the door is intentionally left open about 4 inches for them. They are very shy and skittish, and typically avoid guests entirely. You’ll also notice two goats and a horse in the adjacent pasture. They’re sweet animals, but please don’t feed them — the horse can be a little mouthy, so enjoying them from the fence is best.
